title: 小兒外科
intro: 本科程序庫涵蓋新生兒外科急症（食道閉鎖、先天性橫膈疝氣、腹裂與臍膨出、腸旋轉不良與中腸扭轉、壞死性腸炎、無肛症、巨結腸症）、嬰兒肥厚性幽門狹窄、腸套疊、小兒闌尾炎、疝氣與陰囊水腫、隱睪、小兒創傷與燒傷、兒童輸液與體溫、家長溝通與同意、兒童麻醉協作、術後照護與交班。
introEn: This library covers neonatal surgical emergencies (oesophageal atresia, congenital diaphragmatic hernia, gastroschisis and omphalocele, malrotation and midgut volvulus, necrotising enterocolitis, anorectal malformation, Hirschsprung disease), infantile pyloric stenosis, intussusception, paediatric appendicitis, hernia and hydrocele, undescended testis, paediatric trauma and burns, fluids and temperature in children, communication and consent with parents, paediatric anaesthesia teamwork, postoperative care and handover.

procedures.title: 產前諮詢與新生兒外科轉送：從異常超音波到到院交班
procedures.titleEn: Antenatal counselling and neonatal surgical transfer: from the anomaly scan to arrival handover
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：29 歲孕婦，22 週超音波發現胎兒左側橫膈疝氣。胎兒醫學主治、小兒外科主治、新生兒科醫師與新生兒轉送團隊共同參與。本單元教產前諮詢、分娩計畫、出生後穩定與轉送交班的決策，屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 29-year-old pregnant woman; the 22-week scan shows a fetal left diaphragmatic hernia. The fetal medicine attending, paediatric surgeon, neonatologist and neonatal transport team take part. Teaches counselling, birth planning, post-natal stabilisation and transfer handover decisions; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stages.title: 超音波的發現
stages.evidence: 超音波技師：胎兒胸腔見胃泡，心臟被推向右側，腹圍偏小。
stages.evidenceEn: Sonographer: the fetal stomach bubble sits in the chest, the heart is pushed to the right and the abdominal circumference is small.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 疑左側橫膈疝氣，轉胎兒醫學中心
choices.en: Suspected left CDH: refer to fetal medicine

choices.zh: 胎位造成的正常變異，常規追蹤即可
choices.en: A positional normal variant; routine follow-up

choices.zh: 先天性肺囊腺瘤，等出生後再來處理
choices.en: Congenital lung malformation; deal with it after birth

stages.reason: 胸腔內胃泡加縱膈移位是左側橫膈疝氣的典型產前徵象；需專科中心確認與分期。
stages.reasonEn: An intrathoracic stomach with mediastinal shift is the classic antenatal picture of a left diaphragmatic hernia; it needs specialist confirmation and staging.
stages.pitfall: 若當正常追蹤：孩子在沒有準備的社區醫院出生，第一口氣就缺氧。
stages.pitfallEn: Labelled normal, the baby is born unprepared in a community unit and is hypoxic from the first breath.

stages.title: 多專科會議的預後指標
stages.evidence: 胎兒醫學主治問：哪些指標決定我們怎麼跟家長談預後？
stages.evidenceEn: The fetal medicine attending asks which markers shape how prognosis is discussed with the parents.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 胸腔內胃泡的大小與確切位置
choices.en: Size and exact position of the stomach bubble

choices.zh: 母親年齡與過去生產史
choices.en: Maternal age and obstetric history

choices.zh: 羊水量多寡與胎動情形
choices.en: Amniotic fluid volume and movements

choices.zh: 肺頭比與肝臟是否疝入胸腔
choices.en: Lung-to-head ratio and liver position

stages.reason: 肺容積指標與肝臟位置預測肺發育不全與肺動脈高壓的嚴重度，是諮詢的核心。
stages.reasonEn: Lung-volume indices and liver position predict the severity of pulmonary hypoplasia and hypertension and anchor the counselling.
stages.pitfall: 若用錯指標：家長被給了過度樂觀或過度悲觀的期待。
stages.pitfallEn: The wrong marker leaves the parents with false optimism or needless despair.

stages.title: 家長問：孩子會活嗎？
stages.titleEn: The parents ask whether the baby will live
stages.evidence: 母親哭著問存活率；住院醫師想說「現在醫學很進步，不用擔心」。
stages.evidenceEn: The mother asks the survival rate in tears; the resident wants to say modern medicine means there is nothing to worry about.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 告訴她醫學很進步，一定沒問題
choices.en: Medicine is advanced; it will be fine

choices.zh: 這不是我們的事，交給產科再談
choices.en: Not our area; leave it to obstetrics

choices.zh: 誠實說明預後並提供書面資訊
choices.en: Explain prognosis honestly and give written information

stages.reason: 諮詢必須平衡、可重複、允許提問；家長需要時間消化而非安慰話。
stages.reasonEn: Counselling must be balanced, repeatable and open to questions; parents need time to absorb, not reassurance.
stages.pitfall: 若保證沒事：孩子需要葉克膜時，家長覺得被欺騙。
stages.pitfallEn: A promise of safety is remembered as a lie when the baby needs ECMO.

stages.title: 遺傳與心臟評估
stages.evidence: 家長問要不要做羊膜穿刺；胎兒心臟超音波尚未安排。
stages.evidenceEn: The parents ask about amniocentesis; the fetal echocardiogram has not been booked.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 提供染色體檢查與胎兒心臟超音波
choices.en: Chromosomal testing and fetal echocardiography

choices.zh: 診斷已經很明確，不需要其他檢查
choices.en: The diagnosis is clear; no more tests

choices.zh: 只安排心臟超音波，不必做穿刺
choices.en: Echo only; no amniocentesis

stages.reason: 橫膈疝氣合併染色體異常或心臟畸形者預後截然不同，影響家長的所有決定。
stages.reasonEn: Hernias with chromosomal or cardiac anomalies carry a very different prognosis and change every decision the parents make.
stages.pitfall: 若未篩檢：出生後才發現致死性染色體異常，家庭毫無準備。
stages.pitfallEn: Unscreened, a lethal chromosomal anomaly is discovered after birth with the family unprepared.

stages.title: 分娩計畫
stages.evidence: 產科想在原本的社區醫院自然產；孕婦住在三小時車程外。
stages.evidenceEn: Obstetrics suggests delivering at the local community hospital; she lives three hours away.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 在社區醫院生，出生後再轉送即可
choices.en: Deliver locally; transfer after birth

choices.zh: 在有小兒外科與葉克膜的中心生產
choices.en: Deliver at a centre with paediatric surgery and ECMO

choices.zh: 提早安排剖腹產，減少產程風險
choices.en: Early caesarean to cut labour risk

stages.reason: 子宮內轉送比出生後轉送安全；足月分娩且不因疝氣本身選擇剖腹。
stages.reasonEn: In-utero transfer is safer than transferring a sick newborn; aim for term delivery and do not choose caesarean for the hernia itself.
stages.pitfall: 若在社區醫院生：第一小時的通氣錯誤已造成不可逆肺損傷。
stages.pitfallEn: Born in a community unit, the first hour of wrong ventilation does irreversible lung damage.

stages.title: 產房團隊簡報
stages.evidence: 新生兒科醫師帶領簡報；助產師問要準備什麼。
stages.evidenceEn: The neonatologist leads the brief; the midwife asks what to set up.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 依常規新生兒復甦準備即可
choices.en: The standard newborn resuscitation set-up is enough

choices.zh: 等小兒外科醫師到場再準備
choices.en: Wait for the surgeon before preparing

choices.zh: 備插管與胃管，約定不用面罩
choices.en: Prepare intubation and a gastric tube; agree no mask

stages.reason: 事先約定的角色與「不面罩」原則避免腸道充氣壓迫肺臟。
stages.reasonEn: Pre-agreed roles and a no-mask rule stop the bowel inflating and compressing the lung.
stages.pitfall: 若用常規流程：面罩通氣把腸子吹脹，胸腔更無空間。
stages.pitfallEn: A routine approach inflates the bowel with the mask and leaves even less room for the lung.

stages.title: 出生的瞬間
stages.evidence: 孩子出生後喘息、發紫；助產師反射性拿起面罩開始正壓。
stages.evidenceEn: The baby is born gasping and cyanosed; the midwife reflexively starts mask ventilation.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 停止面罩，插管並放胃管減壓
choices.en: Stop the mask, intubate and decompress

choices.zh: 繼續面罩正壓，直到血氧改善
choices.en: Keep bagging until saturations improve

choices.zh: 先觀察一分鐘看是否自行改善
choices.en: Watch a minute to see if he improves

stages.reason: 每一次面罩擠壓都把氣體送進胸腔內的腸子；插管與胃管減壓是第一步。
stages.reasonEn: Every mask squeeze pushes gas into intrathoracic bowel; intubation and gastric decompression come first.
stages.pitfall: 若繼續面罩：胃腸脹大、縱膈再移位、心輸出量下降。
stages.pitfallEn: Continued mask ventilation distends the gut, shifts the mediastinum further and drops cardiac output.

stages.title: 轉送前檢查
stages.evidence: 轉送團隊到達；氣管內管位置尚未用 X 光確認，胃管接著夾住。
stages.evidenceEn: The transport team arrives; tube position has not been confirmed on X-ray and the gastric tube is clamped.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 時間寶貴，立即出發路上再處理
choices.en: Time matters; go and fix things en route

choices.zh: 確認管位與胃管引流後再出發
choices.en: Confirm the tube and gastric drainage before leaving

choices.zh: 等家長把所有文件都簽完再出發
choices.en: Wait for every form to be signed

stages.reason: 「先穩定再轉送」：途中能做的事很少，出發前就要排除可預期的失敗。
stages.reasonEn: Stabilise then transfer: little can be done in a moving ambulance, so predictable failures are removed before leaving.
stages.pitfall: 若夾住胃管出發：途中腸子再脹，血氧在高速公路上掉。
stages.pitfallEn: A clamped gastric tube lets the bowel re-distend and saturations fall on the motorway.

stages.title: 途中突發
stages.evidence: 救護車上血氧突降、胸廓起伏變小；護理師想直接調高壓力。
stages.evidenceEn: In the ambulance saturations fall and chest movement diminishes; the nurse wants to turn up the pressures.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 直接調高通氣壓力，看血氧是否回升
choices.en: Turn the ventilation pressure up and see if saturation recovers

choices.zh: 加強鎮靜，減少人機對抗
choices.en: More sedation for ventilator fighting

choices.zh: 系統排除管路、氣胸與設備問題
choices.en: Systematically exclude tube, pneumothorax and equipment causes

stages.reason: DOPES 式的排除法在轉送中比盲目加壓更可能找到原因，也避免製造氣胸。
stages.reasonEn: A DOPES-style search finds the cause more often than blind pressure increases and avoids creating a pneumothorax.
stages.pitfall: 若盲目加壓：發育不全的對側肺破裂成張力性氣胸。
stages.pitfallEn: Blind pressure increases rupture the hypoplastic contralateral lung into a tension pneumothorax.

stages.title: 到院交班
stages.evidence: 新生兒加護團隊等候；轉送醫師準備交班。
stages.evidenceEn: The neonatal intensive care team is waiting; the transport doctor prepares to hand over.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 結構化交班含通氣趨勢與血氧差
choices.en: Structured handover with ventilation trends and saturation gap

choices.zh: 口頭說「橫膈疝氣，目前還好」
choices.en: Just say verbally that the CDH baby is doing fine

choices.zh: 把轉送紀錄放在床尾即可
choices.en: Just leave the transfer notes at the end of the cot

stages.reason: 結構化交班讓接手團隊看見趨勢而非一個數值，並維持對家長說法的一致。
stages.reasonEn: Structured handover gives the receiving team trends rather than a single number and keeps the message to the parents consistent.
stages.pitfall: 若交班零碎：肺高壓惡化的趨勢沒人看見，家長聽到兩套說法。
stages.pitfallEn: A fragmented handover hides the worsening pulmonary hypertension and the parents hear two different stories.

procedures.title: 食道閉鎖與氣管食道瘻管：分型、風險分級與修補
procedures.titleEn: Oesophageal atresia with tracheo-oesophageal fistula: typing, risk stratification and repair
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：足月男嬰，出生後口水泡沫多，第一次餵食嗆咳發紫。小兒外科主治、新生兒科醫師、小兒麻醉科醫師與刷手護理師共同照護。本單元教分型、術前穩定、合併異常篩檢、修補原則與併發症辨識，不含藥物劑量與呼吸器參數；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: term boy with frothy oral secretions who chokes and turns blue at the first feed. The paediatric surgeon, neonatologist, paediatric anaesthetist and scrub nurse care for him together. Teaches typing, preoperative stabilisation, screening for associated anomalies, repair principles and complication recognition, without drug doses or ventilator settings; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stages.title: 第一個線索
stages.evidence: 口水不斷冒泡、第一次餵食嗆咳發紫；助產師想再試一次餵奶。
stages.evidenceEn: Continuous frothy saliva and a choking, cyanotic first feed; the midwife wants to try feeding again.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 可能嗆到，換奶嘴再試一次
choices.en: He choked; try another teat

choices.zh: 停餵，放胃管並照 X 光
choices.en: Stop feeds, pass a gastric tube and X-ray

choices.zh: 先觀察到明天看是否改善
choices.en: Observe until tomorrow to see

stages.reason: 口水無法下嚥加嗆咳是食道閉鎖的典型表現；胃管受阻是床邊第一個診斷工具。
stages.reasonEn: Unswallowed saliva with choking is the classic picture of oesophageal atresia; a tube that will not pass is the first bedside diagnostic test.
stages.pitfall: 若再餵：奶水吸入肺部，手術前就併發吸入性肺炎。
stages.pitfallEn: Another feed is aspirated and the baby goes to theatre with pneumonitis.

stages.title: X 光的判讀
stages.evidence: 胃管在上胸部捲曲；腹部有腸氣。
stages.evidenceEn: The tube coils in the upper chest; there is gas in the abdomen.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 純食道閉鎖，沒有任何瘻管
choices.en: Pure oesophageal atresia with no fistula at all

choices.zh: H 型瘻管，食道本身連續
choices.en: H-type fistula with a continuous oesophagus

choices.zh: 閉鎖合併遠端氣管食道瘻管
choices.en: Atresia with a distal fistula, the commonest type

stages.reason: 腹部有氣代表氣管與遠端食道相通；無氣腹則指向純閉鎖或長段缺損。
stages.reasonEn: Abdominal gas means the trachea communicates with the distal oesophagus; a gasless abdomen points to pure atresia and a long gap.
stages.pitfall: 若分型錯誤：手術計畫與家長被告知的時間表都不對。
stages.pitfallEn: The wrong type gives the wrong operative plan and the wrong timeline for the parents.

stages.title: 術前穩定
stages.evidence: 住院醫師放了普通鼻胃管接間歇抽吸；孩子平躺。
stages.evidenceEn: The resident has placed an ordinary nasogastric tube on intermittent suction; the baby lies flat.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 改雙腔管持續低壓抽吸，頭高位
choices.en: Double-lumen tube on continuous suction, head up

choices.zh: 目前處置已經足夠，平躺維持即可
choices.en: The current set-up is fine; keep flat

choices.zh: 預防性插管並給正壓，以避免吸入
choices.en: Intubate prophylactically against aspiration

stages.reason: 持續抽吸近端盲袋防止口水吸入；頭高位減少胃酸經瘻管逆流入氣管。
stages.reasonEn: Continuous suction of the proximal pouch prevents saliva aspiration; head-up positioning limits gastric reflux through the fistula into the trachea.
stages.pitfall: 若間歇抽吸：盲袋滲漏，右上肺葉吸入性肺炎。
stages.pitfallEn: Intermittent suction lets the pouch overflow into the right upper lobe.

stages.title: 心臟超音波的意義
stages.evidence: 主治堅持手術前要有心臟超音波；住院醫師問為什麼不能明天再做。
stages.evidenceEn: The attending insists on echocardiography before surgery; the resident asks why it cannot wait until tomorrow.
stages.question: 這一步的主要理由是？
stages.questionEn: What is the main reason for this step?

choices.zh: 這只是常規流程，明天再做也無妨
choices.en: Just routine; tomorrow is fine

choices.zh: 找右位主動脈弓，決定開胸側別
choices.en: To find a right aortic arch and decide the side

choices.zh: 主要是為了評估是否需要使用葉克膜
choices.en: Mainly to decide on ECMO

stages.reason: 右位主動脈弓時由左側開胸較安全；重大心臟畸形是死亡率的主要預測因子。
stages.reasonEn: A right-sided arch favours a left thoracotomy; major cardiac disease is the main predictor of mortality.
stages.pitfall: 若未做：右側開胸遇到主動脈弓擋在吻合處。
stages.pitfallEn: Without it, a right thoracotomy meets the aortic arch lying across the anastomosis.

stages.title: VACTERL 篩檢
stages.evidence: 護理師發現孩子只有一個臍動脈、拇指發育不良。
stages.evidenceEn: The nurse notes a single umbilical artery and a hypoplastic thumb.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 單一臍動脈是巧合，不需追查
choices.en: A single umbilical artery is coincidence

choices.zh: 只需送染色體檢查就足夠
choices.en: Chromosomes alone are enough

choices.zh: 篩檢腎臟、脊椎、肢體與肛門
choices.en: Screen kidneys, spine, limbs and anus

stages.reason: VACTERL 關聯常合併出現；肛門與腎臟異常會改變手術順序與尿路照護。
stages.reasonEn: VACTERL anomalies cluster; anorectal and renal anomalies alter the operative sequence and urinary care.
stages.pitfall: 若漏掉無肛症：術後第二天才發現孩子沒排便。
stages.pitfallEn: A missed anorectal malformation is discovered when no stool has passed by day two.

stages.title: 風險分級
stages.evidence: 出生體重 2.9 公斤、心臟超音波僅見小型心室中隔缺損。
stages.evidenceEn: Birth weight 2.9 kg and only a small ventricular septal defect on echo.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: Spitz 第一組：預後最佳群
choices.en: Spitz group I: the best-prognosis group

choices.zh: Spitz 第三組：高死亡風險
choices.en: Spitz group III: a high mortality risk

choices.zh: Spitz 第二組：中度風險
choices.en: Spitz group II: intermediate risk

stages.reason: Spitz 分級以出生體重與重大心臟畸形為軸；小型中隔缺損不屬重大畸形。
stages.reasonEn: The Spitz classification uses birth weight and major cardiac anomaly; a small septal defect is not a major anomaly.
stages.pitfall: 若過度分級：家長被告知過高的死亡風險。
stages.pitfallEn: Over-grading tells the parents a mortality that is not theirs.

stages.title: 家長同意
stages.evidence: 父親問：「修好就一切正常了嗎？」
stages.evidenceEn: The father asks whether the repair makes everything normal.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 是的，修好以後就和一般孩子一樣
choices.en: Yes; after repair he will be like any child

choices.zh: 說明滲漏、狹窄、逆流等長期問題
choices.en: Explain leak, stricture, reflux and other long-term issues

choices.zh: 先只談手術當天的風險就好
choices.en: Only the risks of the day itself

stages.reason: 食道閉鎖是終身的狀況；誠實的長期圖像讓家長成為追蹤的夥伴。
stages.reasonEn: Oesophageal atresia is a lifelong condition; an honest long-term picture makes the parents partners in follow-up.
stages.pitfall: 若說修好就正常：第一次狹窄擴張時家長崩潰且不信任團隊。
stages.pitfallEn: Told it will be normal, the parents fall apart at the first stricture dilatation and lose trust.

stages.title: 麻醉誘導的險境
stages.evidence: 正壓通氣後腹部迅速鼓脹、血氧下降。
stages.evidenceEn: After positive-pressure ventilation the abdomen distends rapidly and saturations fall.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 加大通氣壓力以改善血氧
choices.en: Increase ventilation pressure to improve saturations

choices.zh: 放胃管抽氣就能解決問題
choices.en: Passing a gastric tube to vent the air will fix it

choices.zh: 氣經瘻管入胃，需調整管端
choices.en: Fistula gas into the stomach: reposition the tube

stages.reason: 瘻管讓氣體走捷徑進胃，胃脹再壓迫橫膈；這是麻醉與外科必須同步的時刻。
stages.reasonEn: The fistula shunts gas into the stomach, which then splints the diaphragm; anaesthetist and surgeon must act together.
stages.pitfall: 若加壓：胃穿孔或無法通氣，孩子在開胸前就心跳停止。
stages.pitfallEn: More pressure ruptures the stomach or makes ventilation impossible before the chest is open.

stages.title: 瘻管結紮
stages.evidence: 經右側後外側開胸、胸膜外進入；瘻管已顯露，住院醫師準備在離氣管一公分處結紮。
stages.evidenceEn: Right posterolateral extrapleural thoracotomy; the fistula is exposed and the resident plans to ligate a centimetre from the trachea.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 緊貼氣管結紮，避免留下憩室
choices.en: Ligate flush with the trachea; no diverticulum

choices.zh: 在離氣管一公分處結紮較安全
choices.en: Ligating a centimetre away from the trachea is safer

choices.zh: 不結紮，直接進行食道吻合
choices.en: Skip the ligation and go straight to the anastomosis

stages.reason: 殘留的瘻管殘端成為氣管憩室，分泌物堆積與瘻管復發的來源。
stages.reasonEn: A long fistula stump becomes a tracheal diverticulum that pools secretions and seeds recurrence.
stages.pitfall: 若留長殘端：反覆肺炎與瘻管復發。
stages.pitfallEn: A long stump brings recurrent pneumonia and a recurrent fistula.

stages.title: 張力下的吻合
stages.evidence: 兩端距離兩個椎體；吻合後縫線緊繃。
stages.evidenceEn: The ends lie two vertebral bodies apart; the completed anastomosis is taut.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 照常拔管回病房，隔天就開始餵食
choices.en: Extubate as usual, return to the ward and feed tomorrow

choices.zh: 跨吻合口餵管，鎮靜屈頸數日
choices.en: Transanastomotic tube, sedation and neck flexion

choices.zh: 吻合張力太大，應改為食道造口
choices.en: Too tight; convert to oesophagostomy

stages.reason: 減少吻合口張力的術後策略降低滲漏；頸部伸展會把兩端拉開。
stages.reasonEn: Postoperative strategies that reduce tension lower leak rates; neck extension pulls the ends apart.
stages.pitfall: 若立刻拔管活動：吻合口在第三天裂開。
stages.pitfallEn: Early extubation and movement split the anastomosis on day three.

stages.title: 術後第四天
stages.evidence: 引流管出現口水樣液體、發燒、心跳上升。
stages.evidenceEn: Saliva-like fluid appears in the chest drain with fever and tachycardia.
stages.question: 最可能的原因是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most likely cause?

choices.zh: 胸壁傷口感染，加強換藥即可
choices.en: A chest wound infection; more dressings are enough

choices.zh: 吸入性肺炎，加開抗生素即可
choices.en: Aspiration pneumonia; just add antibiotics

choices.zh: 吻合口滲漏：引流並延後進食
choices.en: Anastomotic leak: drain and delay feeds

stages.reason: 滲漏多在一週內出現；多數小滲漏在引流下自行癒合，但必須被辨識。
stages.reasonEn: Leaks declare within the first week; most small leaks heal with drainage, but only if recognised.
stages.pitfall: 若當肺炎：縱膈炎與敗血症。
stages.pitfallEn: Treated as pneumonia, it becomes mediastinitis and sepsis.

stages.title: 出院與交班
stages.evidence: 吻合口攝影無滲漏，開始經口餵食；三週後門診回來吞嚥困難。
stages.evidenceEn: The contrast study shows no leak and oral feeds start; three weeks later he returns dysphagic.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 吻合口狹窄：安排擴張並追蹤
choices.en: Anastomotic stricture: dilate and follow up

choices.zh: 剛開始進食，吞嚥困難屬正常
choices.en: Feeding difficulty is normal while he is just starting to eat

choices.zh: 立即再次開胸，重新吻合
choices.en: Re-open the chest now and redo it

stages.reason: 狹窄是最常見的晚期併發症，常由逆流助長；多專科長期追蹤是標準。
stages.reasonEn: Stricture is the commonest late complication, often fuelled by reflux; long-term multidisciplinary follow-up is standard.
stages.pitfall: 若未追蹤：食團卡住造成窒息事件。
stages.pitfallEn: Unfollowed, a food bolus impacts and causes a choking event.

procedures.title: 先天性橫膈疝氣：溫和通氣、肺高壓與延遲修補時機
procedures.titleEn: Congenital diaphragmatic hernia: gentle ventilation, pulmonary hypertension and timing of delayed repair
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：足月女嬰，產前未診斷，出生後立即呼吸窘迫，腹部凹陷。新生兒科主治、小兒外科主治、呼吸治療師與小兒心臟科醫師共同處理。本單元教辨識、通氣原則、肺高壓與手術時機，不含呼吸器數值與藥物劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: term girl, not diagnosed antenatally, in respiratory distress immediately after birth with a scaphoid abdomen. The neonatologist, paediatric surgeon, respiratory therapist and paediatric cardiologist manage her. Teaches recognition, ventilation principles, pulmonary hypertension and operative timing without ventilator numbers or drug doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stages.title: 出生後的徵象
stages.evidence: 呼吸窘迫、腹部凹陷、心音偏右、左胸聽到腸音。
stages.evidenceEn: Respiratory distress, scaphoid abdomen, heart sounds displaced to the right and bowel sounds in the left chest.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 新生兒暫時性呼吸急促，給氧
choices.en: Transient tachypnoea of the newborn; give oxygen

choices.zh: 胎便吸入症候群，抽吸後面罩
choices.en: Meconium aspiration; suction and then mask ventilation

choices.zh: 橫膈疝氣：勿面罩，備插管
choices.en: CDH: avoid the mask, prepare to intubate

stages.reason: 凹陷腹部加胸腔腸音是床邊診斷；第一個決定是不要把腸子吹脹。
stages.reasonEn: A scaphoid abdomen with bowel sounds in the chest is a bedside diagnosis; the first decision is not to inflate the bowel.
stages.pitfall: 若當暫時性呼吸急促給面罩：胸腔內腸道脹大，血氧直落。
stages.pitfallEn: Masked as transient tachypnoea, the intrathoracic bowel distends and saturations crash.

stages.title: X 光與分類
stages.evidence: X 光：左胸多個腸氣影，胃管捲入胸腔，縱膈右移。
stages.evidenceEn: X-ray: multiple bowel gas shadows in the left chest, the gastric tube curls into the thorax, mediastinum shifted right.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: Bochdalek 疝氣（後外側）
choices.en: Bochdalek hernia (posterolateral)

choices.zh: Morgagni 疝氣（前方胸骨後）
choices.en: Morgagni hernia (anterior retrosternal)

choices.zh: 橫膈膨升（肌肉薄弱無缺損）
choices.en: Eventration (thin muscle, no true defect)

stages.reason: Bochdalek 位於後外側、多在左側、出生即症狀；Morgagni 位於前方，常較晚被偶然發現。
stages.reasonEn: Bochdalek defects are posterolateral, mostly left-sided and symptomatic at birth; Morgagni defects are anterior and often found incidentally later.
stages.pitfall: 若分類錯：手術入路與對家長的預後說明都錯。
stages.pitfallEn: Misclassification gives the wrong approach and the wrong prognosis for the parents.

stages.title: 胃管的角色
stages.titleEn: The role of the gastric tube
stages.evidence: 插管完成；住院醫師問胃管是否可以等 X 光後再放。
stages.evidenceEn: Intubation is complete; the resident asks whether the gastric tube can wait until after the X-ray.
stages.question: 這一步的主要理由是？
stages.questionEn: What is the main reason for this step?

choices.zh: 可以等 X 光確認肺部情況後再放
choices.en: Wait until the X-ray is reviewed

choices.zh: 立即放置持續引流，減壓胸內腸道
choices.en: Now, on free drainage, to decompress the chest bowel

choices.zh: 既然已經插管通氣了，胃管可有可無
choices.en: Intubated, so the tube is optional

stages.reason: 胸腔內的胃與腸每多一分鐘吞入或通入的氣體，就多壓迫一分肺臟與縱膈。
stages.reasonEn: Every minute of swallowed or ventilated gas in the intrathoracic stomach compresses more lung and mediastinum.
stages.pitfall: 若延後：胃脹把心臟推得更偏，靜脈回流受阻。
stages.pitfallEn: Delay lets the stomach push the heart further over and obstruct venous return.

stages.title: 通氣策略
stages.evidence: 呼吸治療師問目標：血氧要追到正常嗎？
stages.evidenceEn: The respiratory therapist asks whether to chase normal saturations.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 積極追求正常血氧與二氧化碳
choices.en: Aim for normal oxygen and carbon dioxide

choices.zh: 一開始就改用高頻震盪通氣
choices.en: High-frequency oscillation from the outset

choices.zh: 溫和通氣，允許高碳酸血症
choices.en: Gentle ventilation with permissive hypercapnia

stages.reason: 肺發育不全的肺容易被壓力傷害；溫和通氣策略提升存活並減少氣胸。
stages.reasonEn: Hypoplastic lungs are easily injured by pressure; a gentle strategy improves survival and reduces pneumothorax.
stages.pitfall: 若追數值加壓：醫源性氣胸與慢性肺病。
stages.pitfallEn: Chasing numbers with pressure causes iatrogenic pneumothorax and chronic lung disease.

stages.title: 突發惡化
stages.evidence: 穩定兩小時後血氧與血壓驟降，右胸呼吸音消失。
stages.evidenceEn: After two hours of stability saturations and blood pressure drop abruptly and right-sided breath sounds vanish.
stages.question: 最可能的原因是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most likely cause?

choices.zh: 對側張力性氣胸：立即減壓
choices.en: Contralateral tension pneumothorax: decompress now

choices.zh: 肺高壓危象，給血管擴張劑
choices.en: Pulmonary hypertensive crisis; give a vasodilator

choices.zh: 氣管內管滑脫，重新調整深度
choices.en: The tube has slipped; readjust its depth

stages.reason: 健側肺承受全部通氣，是氣胸的高危部位；突發加單側呼吸音消失是臨床診斷。
stages.reasonEn: The better lung takes all the ventilation and is prone to pneumothorax; sudden collapse with absent unilateral breath sounds is a clinical diagnosis.
stages.pitfall: 若等 X 光：心跳在影像回來前停止。
stages.pitfallEn: Waiting for the film, the heart stops before it is read.

stages.title: 肺高壓的評估
stages.evidence: 導管前後血氧差距擴大；心臟超音波顯示右向左分流與右心擴大。
stages.evidenceEn: The pre- and post-ductal saturation gap widens; echo shows right-to-left shunting and a dilated right ventricle.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 立即手術修補，解除肺部壓迫
choices.en: Operate now to relieve the compression

choices.zh: 肺高壓：優化通氣與鎮靜
choices.en: Pulmonary hypertension: optimise ventilation and sedation

choices.zh: 減少鎮靜，讓孩子自己多呼吸
choices.en: Lighten sedation so she breathes more

stages.reason: 出生後肺高壓是主要死因；手術不會改善肺血管阻力，反而加重壓力。
stages.reasonEn: Pulmonary hypertension is the main killer; surgery does not lower pulmonary vascular resistance and adds stress.
stages.pitfall: 若急著開刀：術後肺高壓反彈，孩子在加護病房崩潰。
stages.pitfallEn: Rushing to theatre brings rebound pulmonary hypertension and collapse in intensive care.

stages.title: 家長的問題
stages.evidence: 父親問為何還不開刀，鄰床的孩子都開完了。
stages.evidenceEn: The father asks why surgery has not happened when the baby in the next cot has had his.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 家長很焦慮，今天就加排手術吧
choices.en: The parents are anxious; operate today

choices.zh: 推說手術室今天排不進去
choices.en: Say theatre has no slot today

choices.zh: 說明是生理問題：穩定後再修補
choices.en: Physiology first: repair once stable

stages.reason: 延遲修補至生理穩定是現行標準；家長需要理解等待是治療的一部分。
stages.reasonEn: Delayed repair after physiological stabilisation is the current standard; parents must understand that waiting is treatment.
stages.pitfall: 若為了安撫而手術：為家長的焦慮付出孩子的風險。
stages.pitfallEn: Operating to soothe anxiety pays for the parents' worry with the child's risk.

stages.title: 修補手術
stages.evidence: 肺高壓改善，呼吸器需求下降；術中見後外側缺損大，橫膈邊緣不足。
stages.evidenceEn: Pulmonary hypertension has eased and ventilator needs are falling; at surgery the posterolateral defect is large with little diaphragmatic rim.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 以補片無張力修補並記錄缺損
choices.en: Tension-free patch repair; record the defect

choices.zh: 強行拉攏縫合，避免放置異物
choices.en: Force primary closure to avoid foreign material

choices.zh: 缺損太大，放棄修補先關胸
choices.en: Too big; abandon the repair

stages.reason: 張力性縫合會撕裂或造成胸壁變形；補片修補復發率較高，需在交班中註明。
stages.reasonEn: A tension closure tears or deforms the chest wall; patch repairs recur more often and must be flagged at handover.
stages.pitfall: 若強行縫合：術後早期裂開與再疝氣。
stages.pitfallEn: A forced closure dehisces and re-herniates early.

stages.title: 術後加護
stages.evidence: 術後第二天血氧差距再度擴大、血壓下降。
stages.evidenceEn: On day two the saturation gap widens again and blood pressure falls.
stages.question: 最可能的原因是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most likely cause?

choices.zh: 術後正常變化，繼續觀察即可
choices.en: A normal postoperative change; observe

choices.zh: 肺高壓反彈：回到穩定期策略
choices.en: Rebound pulmonary hypertension: back to the stabilisation strategy

choices.zh: 術後傷口感染，加強抗生素
choices.en: Wound infection; more antibiotics

stages.reason: 手術壓力與疼痛可誘發肺高壓反彈；蜜月期後的惡化必須被預期。
stages.reasonEn: Operative stress and pain trigger rebound pulmonary hypertension; deterioration after the honeymoon period must be anticipated.
stages.pitfall: 若未預期：心輸出量下降到需要葉克膜。
stages.pitfallEn: Unanticipated, cardiac output falls until ECMO is the only option.

stages.title: 長期追蹤與交班
stages.evidence: 準備出院；家長問還要看什麼。
stages.evidenceEn: Ready for discharge; the parents ask what follow-up remains.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 只需定期回小兒外科門診看傷口
choices.en: Only regular surgical clinic visits to check the wound

choices.zh: 修補完成就痊癒，不需追蹤
choices.en: Repaired means cured; no follow-up

choices.zh: 多專科長期追蹤肺與發展
choices.en: Multidisciplinary follow-up of lungs, reflux and development

stages.reason: 橫膈疝氣存活者有長期肺、腸胃、聽力與發展的風險；結構化追蹤是標準。
stages.reasonEn: Survivors carry long-term respiratory, gastrointestinal, hearing and developmental risks; structured follow-up is the standard.
stages.pitfall: 若只看外科：聽力損失到學齡才被發現。
stages.pitfallEn: Surgery-only follow-up finds the hearing loss at school age.

procedures.title: 腹裂與臍膨出：保溫保水、矽膠袋分期復位與關閉
procedures.titleEn: Gastroschisis and omphalocele: heat and fluid preservation, silo staged reduction and closure
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：37 週男嬰，產前診斷腹裂，出生時腸道外露、水腫增厚。小兒外科主治、新生兒科醫師、麻醉科醫師與護理師共同處理。本單元教出生後保護、鑑別臍膨出、復位策略與腹腔高壓辨識，不含輸液速率或藥物劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 37-week boy with antenatally diagnosed gastroschisis, born with exposed, oedematous and thickened bowel. The paediatric surgeon, neonatologist, anaesthetist and nurses manage him. Teaches post-natal protection, distinguishing omphalocele, reduction strategy and recognition of abdominal hypertension without fluid rates or drug doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stages.title: 出生的第一分鐘
stages.evidence: 助產師用濕紗布蓋住腸子；產房冷、孩子哭。
stages.evidenceEn: The midwife covers the bowel with wet gauze; the room is cold and the baby is crying.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 透明腸袋包覆、側躺並放胃管
choices.en: Clear bowel bag, lie on the side, gastric tube

choices.zh: 濕紗布覆蓋就能保濕，繼續即可
choices.en: Wet gauze keeps it moist; carry on

choices.zh: 趁還沒水腫立刻把腸子推回
choices.en: Push the bowel back in now, before it starts to swell

stages.reason: 外露腸道以蒸發與輻射大量失溫失水；塑膠袋同時保溫、保水並可觀察顏色。
stages.reasonEn: Exposed bowel loses heat and fluid by evaporation and radiation; a plastic bag preserves both while the colour stays visible.
stages.pitfall: 若用濕紗布：體溫與血容量在一小時內同時掉。
stages.pitfallEn: Wet gauze drops temperature and circulating volume together within the hour.

stages.title: 鑑別臍膨出
stages.evidence: 隔壁床另一位新生兒腹部腫塊有薄膜覆蓋，臍帶插在膜上，舌頭大。
stages.evidenceEn: In the next cot a newborn has a membrane-covered mass with the cord inserting on the sac and a large tongue.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 腹裂，與隔壁床孩子屬同一疾病
choices.en: Gastroschisis, the same as next door

choices.zh: 臍膨出，需查血糖與合併異常
choices.en: Omphalocele: check glucose and associated anomalies

choices.zh: 只是單純臍疝氣，多數會自行閉合
choices.en: Umbilical hernia; most close alone

stages.reason: 臍膨出有膜且臍帶插在膜上，合併心臟、染色體與 Beckwith–Wiedemann 症候群；腹裂多為孤立。
stages.reasonEn: Omphalocele has a sac with the cord on it and associates with cardiac, chromosomal and Beckwith-Wiedemann anomalies; gastroschisis is usually isolated.
stages.pitfall: 若漏掉大舌症的意義：低血糖抽搐在加護病房發生。
stages.pitfallEn: Missing the meaning of the macroglossia, a hypoglycaemic seizure happens in intensive care.

stages.title: 輸液與體溫
stages.evidence: 尿量少、肢端冷；住院醫師依一般新生兒維持量給輸液。
stages.evidenceEn: Low urine output and cool peripheries; the resident gives standard neonatal maintenance fluids.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 依一般新生兒維持量給予就足夠
choices.en: Standard newborn maintenance fluids are quite enough

choices.zh: 限制輸液以避免腸道水腫
choices.en: Restrict the fluids to avoid making the bowel oedematous

choices.zh: 流失大：依尿量灌流補充並保溫
choices.en: Large losses: replace to urine output and warm

stages.reason: 外露腸道的流失遠超一般維持量；目標導向補液與保溫是術前的核心。
stages.reasonEn: Losses from exposed bowel far exceed maintenance; goal-directed replacement and warming are the heart of preoperative care.
stages.pitfall: 若只給維持量：代謝性酸中毒與低血壓進手術室。
stages.pitfallEn: Maintenance alone sends an acidotic, hypotensive baby to theatre.

stages.title: 腸道顏色改變
stages.evidence: 包覆後三十分鐘，一段腸子轉暗紫，缺損邊緣緊貼腸繫膜。
stages.evidenceEn: Thirty minutes after wrapping, a loop turns dusky and the defect edge is tight against the mesentery.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 缺損壓迫繫膜：擴大或調整解壓
choices.en: The defect is strangling the mesentery: enlarge or reposition

choices.zh: 持續包覆，並觀察腸子顏色是否回復
choices.en: Keep it wrapped and watch whether the bowel colour returns

choices.zh: 暗紫腸段已壞死，直接切除
choices.en: It is dead; resect it

stages.reason: 狹窄的缺損像一條止血帶；解除壓迫比任何處置更先。
stages.reasonEn: A tight defect acts as a tourniquet; relief of the constriction comes before anything else.
stages.pitfall: 若觀察：整段中腸在等待中壞死。
stages.pitfallEn: Watching lets the whole midgut die while waiting.

stages.title: 復位策略
stages.evidence: 腸道增厚、量多，腹腔明顯小；主治問如何復位。
stages.evidenceEn: The bowel is thick and bulky and the abdominal cavity is clearly small; the attending asks how to reduce.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 不論如何一次復位並關閉
choices.en: One-stage reduction and closure regardless

choices.zh: 預製矽膠袋分期復位
choices.en: Preformed silo and staged reduction

choices.zh: 等腸道水腫消退再處理
choices.en: Wait for the oedema to settle

stages.reason: 強行一次復位會造成腹腔高壓；分期復位讓腹腔逐日適應。
stages.reasonEn: Forcing primary reduction causes abdominal hypertension; staged reduction lets the cavity accommodate day by day.
stages.pitfall: 若強行關閉：腎灌流與通氣同時受損。
stages.pitfallEn: A forced closure compromises renal perfusion and ventilation together.

stages.title: 矽膠袋置放
stages.evidence: 床邊置放預製矽膠袋；護理師問如何固定與觀察。
stages.evidenceEn: A preformed silo is placed at the cot side; the nurse asks how to secure and watch it.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 將袋子平放在腹部上，蓋紗布
choices.en: Lay it flat on the abdomen under gauze

choices.zh: 每小時用力擠壓，加快復位速度
choices.en: Squeeze hard hourly to speed reduction

choices.zh: 垂直懸吊，每日觀察腸色與下降
choices.en: Hang it vertically; check colour and descent daily

stages.reason: 重力協助腸道逐步回腹；每次復位都是一次腹壓檢查。
stages.reasonEn: Gravity helps the bowel settle gradually; each reduction is also a check on abdominal pressure.
stages.pitfall: 若擠壓過猛：腸繫膜血管受壓，腸道變色。
stages.pitfallEn: Over-vigorous squeezing compresses the mesenteric vessels and the bowel discolours.

stages.title: 復位時的警訊
stages.evidence: 第三天復位後呼吸器需求上升、尿量下降、雙腿發白。
stages.evidenceEn: After the day-three reduction ventilator requirements rise, urine output falls and the legs blanch.
stages.question: 此時最需警覺的是？
stages.questionEn: What needs the most vigilance now?

choices.zh: 腹腔高壓：鬆開復位並重評
choices.en: Abdominal hypertension: release and reassess

choices.zh: 繼續復位，爭取今天完成關閉
choices.en: Keep reducing to close today

choices.zh: 給予利尿劑，改善尿量與水腫
choices.en: A diuretic for urine and oedema

stages.reason: 通氣壓力上升、少尿與下肢灌流不良是腹腔高壓的三聯徵；處置是減壓而非藥物。
stages.reasonEn: Rising ventilation pressures, oliguria and poor lower-limb perfusion are the triad of abdominal hypertension; treatment is decompression, not drugs.
stages.pitfall: 若繼續：腹腔室症候群與腸壞死。
stages.pitfallEn: Continuing produces abdominal compartment syndrome and bowel necrosis.

stages.title: 關閉
stages.evidence: 第六天腸道全部回到腹腔；主治問關閉方式。
stages.evidenceEn: On day six all bowel is in the abdomen; the attending asks how to close.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 必須在全身麻醉下縫合筋膜
choices.en: Fascial suture under general anaesthesia is mandatory

choices.zh: 依缺損與腹壓選擇關閉方式
choices.en: Choose the closure by defect and pressure

choices.zh: 矽膠袋再留置一個月比較安全
choices.en: Keep the silo another month to be safe

stages.reason: 無縫線關閉減少麻醉與通氣需求；選擇取決於缺損與腹壓，而非慣例。
stages.reasonEn: Sutureless closure avoids anaesthesia and ventilation; the choice follows the defect and pressure, not habit.
stages.pitfall: 若忽略腹壓：關閉後再度出現少尿。
stages.pitfallEn: Ignoring pressure brings oliguria back after closure.

stages.title: 術後營養
stages.evidence: 術後兩週仍腸麻痺，靠靜脈營養；護理師問中心靜脈導管何時可拔。
stages.evidenceEn: Two weeks on, the ileus persists on parenteral nutrition; the nurse asks when the central line can come out.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 立刻開始全量餵食促進蠕動
choices.en: Full feeds now to stimulate the gut

choices.zh: 拔掉中心導管，改成經口餵食
choices.en: Remove the line and feed by mouth

choices.zh: 預期腸麻痺，續靜脈營養慢餵
choices.en: Expected ileus: parenteral nutrition and slow feeds

stages.reason: 腹裂的腸道功能恢復慢；長期靜脈營養的風險是導管感染與膽汁滯留。
stages.reasonEn: Gut function in gastroschisis recovers slowly; prolonged parenteral nutrition risks line infection and cholestasis.
stages.pitfall: 若急著全量餵食：壞死性腸炎。
stages.pitfallEn: Rushing to full feeds precipitates necrotising enterocolitis.

stages.title: 出院與交班
stages.evidence: 準備出院；家長問還要注意什麼。
stages.evidenceEn: Ready for home; the parents ask what to watch.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 衛教嘔吐腹脹警訊並追蹤生長
choices.en: Teach vomiting and distension warning signs; follow growth

choices.zh: 腹壁已關閉就痊癒，不需追蹤
choices.en: The abdominal wall is closed, so he is cured; no follow-up

choices.zh: 終身避免運動，以防腹壁疝氣
choices.en: Avoid all sport for life to prevent an abdominal wall hernia

stages.reason: 腹裂後沾黏性阻塞與生長遲滯常見；家長是出院後的第一線監測者。
stages.reasonEn: Adhesive obstruction and poor growth are common after gastroschisis; the parents are the first monitors at home.
stages.pitfall: 若無衛教：腸阻塞在家拖到脫水。
stages.pitfallEn: Without advice, an obstruction is left at home until dehydration.

procedures.title: 腸旋轉不良與中腸扭轉：膽汁性嘔吐即急症
procedures.titleEn: Malrotation and midgut volvulus: bilious vomiting is an emergency
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：10 天大男嬰，突然膽汁性嘔吐，初期看來尚可。急診主治、小兒外科住院醫師、放射師與麻醉科醫師共同處理。本單元教辨識、影像選擇、何時不等影像直接手術，以及 Ladd 手術原則與腸道活性判斷；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 10-day-old boy with sudden bilious vomiting who initially looks reasonably well. The ED attending, paediatric surgical resident, radiographer and anaesthetist manage him. Teaches recognition, imaging choice, when to go to theatre without imaging, and the principles of the Ladd procedure and bowel viability; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 壞死性腸炎：Bell 分期、內科治療與何時手術
procedures.titleEn: Necrotising enterocolitis: Bell staging, medical management and when to operate
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：28 週早產兒，出生第 12 天，在新生兒加護病房出現餵食不耐與腹脹。新生兒科主治、小兒外科主治、放射師與護理師共同照護。本單元教分期、連續評估、手術指標與術式選擇原則，不含藥物劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 28-week preterm infant on day 12 in neonatal intensive care with feed intolerance and abdominal distension. The neonatologist, paediatric surgeon, radiographer and nurses care for him. Teaches staging, serial assessment, indications for surgery and operative principles without drug doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 巨結腸症：切片邏輯、腸炎與拉通手術
procedures.titleEn: Hirschsprung disease: biopsy logic, enterocolitis and pull-through
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：足月男嬰，48 小時未排胎便，腹脹、膽汁性嘔吐。小兒外科主治、病理科醫師、放射師與造口護理師共同參與。本單元教鑑別、顯影灌腸、直腸切片邏輯、腸炎辨識與拉通手術原則；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: term boy who has not passed meconium by 48 hours, with distension and bilious vomiting. The paediatric surgeon, pathologist, radiographer and stoma nurse take part. Teaches the differential, contrast enema, rectal biopsy logic, enterocolitis recognition and pull-through principles; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 無肛症：24 小時評估、Krickenbeck 分類與分期修補
procedures.titleEn: Anorectal malformation: the 24-hour assessment, Krickenbeck classification and staged repair
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：足月男嬰，新生兒檢查發現無肛門開口。小兒外科主治、新生兒科醫師、小兒泌尿科醫師與造口護理師共同參與。本單元教等待與觀察的邏輯、合併異常篩檢、分類、造口與後矢狀入路修補原則；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: term boy found at the newborn check to have no anal opening. The paediatric surgeon, neonatologist, paediatric urologist and stoma nurse take part. Teaches the logic of waiting and observing, screening for associated anomalies, classification, colostomy and the principles of posterior sagittal repair; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 嬰兒肥厚性幽門狹窄：先矯正代謝紊亂，再做幽門肌切開
procedures.titleEn: Infantile hypertrophic pyloric stenosis: correct the metabolic derangement first, then pyloromyotomy
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：5 週大第一胎男嬰，餵奶後噴射狀非膽汁性嘔吐兩週，體重下降。小兒外科主治、小兒科住院醫師、麻醉科醫師與超音波技師共同處理。本單元教電解質型態、超音波判讀、手術時機與黏膜穿孔辨識，不含輸液配方；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 5-week-old first-born boy with two weeks of projectile non-bilious vomiting after feeds and weight loss. The paediatric surgeon, paediatric resident, anaesthetist and sonographer manage him. Teaches the electrolyte pattern, ultrasound interpretation, timing of surgery and recognition of mucosal perforation without fluid prescriptions; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 新生兒腸阻塞診斷路徑：雙泡徵、胎便腸阻塞與小腸閉鎖
procedures.titleEn: Neonatal bowel obstruction pathway: double bubble, meconium ileus and intestinal atresia
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：出生第一天的足月女嬰，膽汁性嘔吐，腹部不脹。新生兒科主治、小兒外科主治、放射師與遺傳科醫師共同評估。本單元教近端與遠端阻塞的區分、影像選擇與判讀、何時緊急何時可等，以及合併症篩檢；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: term girl on day one with bilious vomiting and a non-distended abdomen. The neonatologist, paediatric surgeon, radiographer and geneticist assess her. Teaches proximal versus distal obstruction, imaging choice and interpretation, what is urgent and what can wait, and screening for associations; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 腸套疊：標靶徵、空氣灌腸復位與手術時機
procedures.titleEn: Intussusception: the target sign, air enema reduction and when to operate
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：8 個月大女嬰，間歇性劇烈哭鬧、雙腿屈曲，發作間隙異常安靜嗜睡。急診主治、小兒外科住院醫師、放射科醫師與護理師共同處理。本單元教辨識、超音波判讀、灌腸前準備、禁忌症、穿孔處置與復發觀察；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 8-month-old girl with intermittent screaming episodes, legs drawn up, and unusual quietness and lethargy between episodes. The ED attending, paediatric surgical resident, radiologist and nurses manage her. Teaches recognition, ultrasound interpretation, pre-enema preparation, contraindications, perforation management and observation for recurrence; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 小兒闌尾炎診斷路徑：評分、先超音波不先 CT
procedures.titleEn: Paediatric appendicitis pathway: scores and ultrasound before CT
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：9 歲女童，右下腹痛 24 小時，食慾不振，發燒。急診主治、小兒外科住院醫師、超音波技師與護理師共同評估。本單元教評分分層、影像選擇、鑑別診斷與觀察策略；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 9-year-old girl with 24 hours of right lower quadrant pain, anorexia and fever. The ED attending, paediatric surgical resident, sonographer and nurses assess her. Teaches score-based stratification, imaging choice, the differential and observation strategy; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 兒童複雜性闌尾炎：穿孔、膿瘍與腹腔鏡闌尾切除
procedures.titleEn: Complicated appendicitis in children: perforation, abscess and laparoscopic appendicectomy
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：6 歲男童，腹痛四天，發燒、腹脹、全腹壓痛。小兒外科主治、麻醉科醫師、刷手護理師與放射科醫師共同處理。本單元教復甦、手術或非手術策略、腹腔鏡安全步驟與術後膿瘍辨識，不含藥物劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 6-year-old boy with four days of abdominal pain, fever, distension and generalised tenderness. The paediatric surgeon, anaesthetist, scrub nurse and radiologist manage him. Teaches resuscitation, operative versus non-operative strategy, safe laparoscopic steps and recognition of postoperative abscess, without drug doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 小兒腹股溝疝氣與陰囊水腫：嵌頓、復位與疝囊高位結紮
procedures.titleEn: Paediatric inguinal hernia and hydrocele: incarceration, reduction and high ligation
procedures.category: 小兒腹股溝與泌尿生殖
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：3 個月大早產男嬰，右側腹股溝間歇性腫塊，今天腫塊變硬、哭鬧、嘔吐。小兒外科主治、麻醉科醫師與病房護理師共同處理。本單元教疝氣與水腫的鑑別、嵌頓復位、手術時機、早產兒麻醉風險與手術原則；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 3-month-old ex-preterm boy with an intermittent right groin swelling that today became firm, with crying and vomiting. The paediatric surgeon, anaesthetist and ward nurses manage him. Teaches hernia versus hydrocele, reduction of incarceration, timing, anaesthetic risk in ex-preterm infants and operative principles; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 隱睪門診：檢查技巧、回縮性睪丸與睪丸固定時機
procedures.titleEn: Undescended testis clinic: examination technique, retractile testis and timing of orchidopexy
procedures.category: 小兒腹股溝與泌尿生殖
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：9 個月大男嬰，家庭醫師轉介「右側摸不到睪丸」。小兒外科主治、門診護理師與小兒內分泌科醫師參與。本單元教檢查技巧、分類、何時不需超音波、手術時機與諮詢重點；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 9-month-old boy referred by his family doctor because the right testis cannot be felt. The paediatric surgeon, clinic nurse and paediatric endocrinologist take part. Teaches examination technique, classification, why ultrasound is usually unnecessary, timing of surgery and counselling; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 兒童急性陰囊：睪丸扭轉的時間窗與鑑別
procedures.titleEn: The acute scrotum in children: the torsion time window and the differential
procedures.category: 小兒腹股溝與泌尿生殖
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：13 歲男孩，突發左側睪丸劇痛三小時，噁心。急診主治、小兒外科住院醫師、超音波技師與麻醉科醫師共同處理。本單元教臨床判斷、何時不等影像、鑑別診斷、手術探查與雙側固定原則；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 13-year-old boy with three hours of sudden severe left testicular pain and nausea. The ED attending, paediatric surgical resident, sonographer and anaesthetist manage him. Teaches clinical judgement, when not to wait for imaging, the differential, exploration and bilateral fixation principles; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 包皮與包莖：生理性不回縮、BXO 與割包皮的安全
procedures.titleEn: Foreskin and phimosis: physiological non-retractility, BXO and safe circumcision
procedures.category: 小兒腹股溝與泌尿生殖
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：4 歲男童，家庭醫師轉介「包莖」，排尿時包皮鼓起。小兒外科主治、門診護理師、麻醉科醫師與刷手護理師參與。本單元教生理與病理包莖的區分、手術指徵、替代療法原則、術前檢查與手術安全，不含藥物劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 4-year-old boy referred for phimosis, with ballooning of the foreskin on voiding. The paediatric surgeon, clinic nurse, anaesthetist and scrub nurse take part. Teaches physiological versus pathological phimosis, indications, alternatives in principle, preoperative examination and operative safety, without drug doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 吞入異物與鈕扣電池：兩小時的競賽
procedures.titleEn: Ingested foreign body and button battery: the two-hour race
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：2 歲女童，一小時前「吞了東西」，流口水、拒食。急診主治、小兒外科／內視鏡醫師、放射師與麻醉科醫師共同處理。本單元教 X 光判讀、電池與硬幣的區分、時間窗、術前緩解原則、取出後評估與磁鐵的特殊風險；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 2-year-old girl who swallowed something an hour ago, now drooling and refusing food. The ED attending, paediatric surgeon or endoscopist, radiographer and anaesthetist manage her. Teaches X-ray interpretation, battery versus coin, the time window, pre-removal mitigation principles, post-removal assessment and the special risk of magnets; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 3-year-old boy who drank alkaline cleaner stored in a drinks bottle, with oral burns and drooling. Teaches first principles, airway assessment, timing of endoscopy and Zargar grading, perforation recognition, long-term follow-up and safeguarding; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 膽道閉鎖與總膽管囊腫：黃疸的時間、Kasai 與囊腫切除

procedures.title: 小兒創傷初級評估：代償性休克、頭部影像決策與 ATMIST 交班

The paediatric surgeon, ward nurses, radiologist and intensive care team care for him. The ED attending, paediatric surgical resident, burns nurse and social worker manage her.
